mastery_task.scenario_en: A new member sends a short voice introduction to a study group.
mastery_task.scenario_ar: عضو جديد يرسل تقديم صوتي قصير لمجموعة دراسة.
mastery_task.prompt_en: Listen without a transcript and record the person's name and three details.
mastery_task.support: Two complete plays and blank field labels only; no transcript or answer-bearing image.
mastery_task.freshness: The voice, person, places, role, and detail order differ from all models.

replacement_mastery_task.scenario_en: A colleague introduces a new fictional teammate in a voice note.
replacement_mastery_task.scenario_ar: زميل يقدّم عضو فريق خيالي جديد في رسالة صوتية.
replacement_mastery_task.prompt_en: Listen without a transcript and identify the person and three facts.
replacement_mastery_task.support: Two complete plays and blank field labels only; no transcript or answer-bearing image.
replacement_mastery_task.freshness: A third-person introduction changes speaker, referent, and all details.

rubric.level_2: The correct person and requested detail types are understood.
The name and three essential facts are recovered accurately.
Details are captured from a new voice and changed order without a transcript.
A second full listen is used without guessing or changing attribution.

decision.demonstrated: Level 2 or above on every required dimension.
decision.needs_review: Any required dimension below level 2; use targeted practice and a new task.
decision.completion_rule: Opening sections or finishing exercises never grants mastery.

teach_back_variant.prompt_ar: اشرح إزاي I وhe وshe بيساعدوك تعرف المعلومة تخص مين.

omit_variant.content: Proceed directly to the matched close and review card.

delayed_review.task: Capture three facts from a new self-introduction.
Identify the referent in a third-person introduction.
Complete a new two-pass introduction capture.
